links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers on pediatric space maintainers (FRES, FKRGL)
links.effect: Readability scores for both ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 required college-degree education, above typical patient/parent reading levels.
links.quote: The readability scores seemed to require an education of a college degree and the similarity levels were lesser than 10% for both chatbots whit a high originality.

screen.reason: Evaluates quality, readability, and reliability of ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 answering 12 questions on pediatric space maintainers without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
